text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek fights hard against some<n>formidable
opponents but fails to<n>emerge victorious.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She accepts the results, resolving to<n>stay
level-headed and continue<n>improving.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, she reflects on our<n>hardships and
how those trials have<n>helped us grow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She then expresses her hope to race<n>in the Osaka
Hai next.
